opening.argument: The material is presented as a technical walkthrough: viewers are shown how to buy ETH, connect Trust Wallet, enter a token address, and use Uniswap to exchange ETH for FLUT. The sequence is procedural, with a wallet-connection dialog and a confirmation screen showing ETH as the input and FLUT as the output, but no completed transfer. Its own description limits the presentation further, stating, "I have only shared technical processes not financial advice Invest in crypto at your own risk." It also says, "I don't Recommend Investing, I'm just doing Reviews, I've never said they're legit, I've Never said They're Scam". The video therefore explains an operational process without promising profits or asserting the token's legitimacy.
